title: Unit and counit of a monoidal adjunction are monoidal
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be monoidal categories, let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be strong monoidal and $G:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ lax monoidal, and let $F\dashv G$ be an adjunction whose lax structure on $G$ is the mate of the inverse monoidal structure on $F$ (mates in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]). Write $u:\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}\Rightarrow GF$ and $c:FG\Rightarrow\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal D}$ for its unit and counit, with the natural Hom-bijection convention of [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. Then $u$ and $c$ are monoidal natural transformations, for the composite lax monoidal structures on $GF$ and $FG$. Here a natural transformation $t:H\Rightarrow K$ of lax monoidal functors is monoidal when $t_{\mathbf1}\circ\varepsilon^H=\varepsilon^K$ and $t_{X\otimes Y}\circ\mu^H_{X,Y}=\mu^K_{X,Y}\circ(t_X\otimes t_Y)$ for all objects $X,Y$.
